verdict.rationale: The evidence describes no first-run setup wizard. Installation and initial configuration are documented as Docker, npm or Helm installs, with model endpoints, credentials and defaults set by editing librechat.yaml, .env and docker-compose.override.yml. The browser-based Admin Panel (per-role/group config overrides) and the runtime MCP Settings panel are adjacent configuration UIs, not a guided first-run walkthrough of credentials, channels and defaults, so they earn no credit here.
